answer.reason: Both design and make test and measurement instruments sold to B2B customers worldwide, including aerospace and defense. AMETEK also sells motion control, interconnects, specialty metals and analytical instruments for industrial, medical and power markets. Viavi focuses on network test and assurance and optical coatings for telecom, data center and anti-counterfeiting. The product and customer overlap is real but partial.

C:P1.1.text: VIAVI Solutions | Network Test, Monitoring, and Assurance

C:P1.2.text: VIAVI is a global leader in test and measurement and optical technologies

C:P1.3.text: Our test, monitoring, assurance, and resilient position, navigation and timing solutions enable and secure critical infrastructure ranging from data center ecosystems and communication networks to military, aerospace, railway and first responder communications. In addition, we develop and advance technologies used in high-volume optical applications across anti-counterfeiting, consumer electronics, aerospace, industrial and automotive end markets.

C:P1.5.text: From testing, assuring, and securing the largest communications networks around the globe, to the coatings and filters that make your car’s spatial sensing possible, our technologies have a diverse impact on the world. Discover how we enable new possibilities that touch every area of life.

C:P3.2.text: VIAVI is a global leader in test and measurement and optical technologies. Our test, monitoring, assurance, and resilient position, navigation and timing solutions enable and secure critical infrastructure ranging from data center ecosystems and communication networks to military, aerospace, railway and first responder communications. In addition, we develop and advance technologies used in high-volume optical applications across anti-counterfeiting, consumer electronics, aerospace, industrial and automotive end markets.

C:P3.3.text: 2023 marks a historic 100-year milestone for VIAVI. Our strategic acquisitions have enabled VIAVI to evolve into the company we are today. We are proud to have partnered with our customers to develop disruptive innovations over the course of history.
